item.title: Kevin Ellis Faces Life in Prison After Jury’s Verdict
item.description: Kevin Ellis faces life in prison after he was convicted of murdering his brother-in-law, Matthew Restelli. Ellis is set to be sentenced in March. (1/29/26)

item.title: ‘I Hate You’: Victim’s Daughter Confronts Susan Embert at Sentencing
